cAdvisorScrapingMode.description: cAdvisor scraping mode: auto (failover), direct (nodes only), nodeProxy (API proxy only)

clusterName.description: Cluster name, rendered through tpl so it can reference other chart values (e.g. '{{ .Values.global.cluster.name }}')

snapshotIntervalCycles.description: Cluster snapshots are taken every N settings-refresh cycles; one cycle is SETTINGS_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES (10 by default). 12 = every 2 hours, 3 = every 30 minutes. Accepts a number, a digit string, or "" for the default. Rejects values below 1, which disable snapshots entirely, and leading zeros, which urfave/cli parses as octal ("010" would silently mean 8).
